title: 2008 Upper Deck First Edition - Starquest Common #SQ-38 Cole Hamels Phillies
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2008 Upper Deck First Edition sports trading card features Cole Hamels of the Philadelphia Phillies in the Starquest Common insert set. The card number is SQ-38 and it is a parallel/variety card with a common design. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection and perfect for those who love the Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is not autographed and was manufactured by Upper Deck in 2008. Get this unique card today and add it to your sports memorabilia collection!
